name: Parametric Studio Bridge
tagline: Drag a slider in the browser; the Rhino model updates in about 200 ms.

page.objective: Give a browser-based parametric studio live two-way control of Grasshopper inside Rhino.
page.problem: Parametric exploration was locked inside Grasshopper, where only one person could drive it.
page.solution: A bridge syncs browser sliders to Grasshopper and regenerates the brep in the viewport in real time, with an MCP connector so an assistant can drive Rhino too.
